news.headline: The TJX Companies, Inc. Reports Third Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results
news.summary: The TJX Companies, Inc. announced its financial results for the third quarter ended October 31, 2026, reporting net sales of $16.0 billion and a 4% increase in consolidated comparable sales.

news.headline: Take-Two's Rockstar Games Promoting 'GTA VI' in China Despite Lack of Approval
news.summary: Rockstar Games is reportedly promoting its upcoming title 'Grand Theft Auto VI' in China, despite the game not having received the necessary official sales approval in the region.

news.headline: Take-Two Interactive's Firaxis Games Announces Staff Reductions
news.summary: Take-Two Interactive's subsidiary, Firaxis Games, has reportedly laid off approximately one-third of its workforce.

news.headline: Take-Two Interactive Announces NBA 2K27 and Rockstar Games Collaboration
news.summary: Take-Two Interactive's 2K and Rockstar Games labels are partnering to integrate "Vice City" content into the NBA 2K27 video game.
